ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed in the mid-sections of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized vertical white striations and mottling located between the 40% and 70% width mark of each lobe; the remaining peripheral and basal areas consist of solid low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with high pixel-amplitude valleys; right lobe distal edge exhibits significantly deeper indentations (valleys) than the left lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve from base to apex on both lobes, terminating in sharp, upward-pointing tips (apices).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization located exclusively on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the dark pigmented inner surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips; deep irregular notches on the trailing edge indicating historical tissue loss/mechanical wear.
